cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your school meeting went fine, love. The headteacher and I discussed your suspension. Have some tea. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. A little while. I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come sit beside me. You don't have to face this alone.

mechanism: A manages a child school problem by offering increasingly personal care while progressively withholding suspension details.
confusable: Unlike lying outright or cold stonewalling, factual detail dwindles as concrete warmth and accommodations increase.
comparison: Parental school-play worry differs from a customer trying to retrieve a wedding dress.
seedUse: D141-a suspension, tea and school play; S02-a adapts practical plans to keep the other person close.
